datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a regular monthly schedule (October-December 2020) across El Salvador administrative units. The data represents medium-term projections of acute food insecurity phases, which are indirect impacts of underlying hazards (primarily drought and economic shocks). Geographic boundaries and IPC phase classifications were compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats for spatial analysis.
